title: Trap B: learner proposes an activity list
goal: List what the team did each day; never name customers kept; other beats strong.
must_avoid: Rebecca proposing a label, list, note or plan

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you plan to do about Jamie's mistakes
examples: I'd write down what actually happened, six weeks out of eight with mistakes, and a couple of examples. Then I'd talk it through with her, hear her side, and work out together what a good email should look like.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you will put in the summary or follows up
intents.do: Activity list only, even after a follow-up
examples: I'd add more detail about what everyone worked on each day.
Yeah, I'd just list what everyone did, tickets and calls and hours.

intents.when: Rebecca asks what you will say to Chloe
examples: I'd catch her this week, just the two of us. I'd say, On that call last week you jumped in a few times and the client went quiet after that. Next time, try letting them finish first.

intents.when: Rebecca explains Dylan's late report and the software and asks what you will do
examples: I'd get him trained on the software, ask for the report on time from next week, and check in with him every week for a month.
